Something deep inside me makes me, think there's no way humans will not want human made things.
I mean, I think we're, we're just naturally art making people.
It's one of the first things we do when we, leave the womb.
We start, we can't talk but we're singing and babbling.
And we can't even walk yet, but you sort of dance a bit or tap things or react to things like that.

And I think the universe is full of music. That's where it comes from. And art, I mean, I think it's basically... I, I also, I love, the part where you said... You were talking about how AI... When AI beat, AlphaGo, be the human player.
Yeah.

Exactly. Yes. You recognize the pattern Yeah. And you break it. Yeah. And that's the creativity.
And in many fields, again, I I would love to hear your views on music because I I... I'm not really an expert in music.

But certainly in games like Go and chess, now AI is far more creative than humans. You know, when you have this kind of humans only competition and there is always this fear that somebody's getting advice from an AI, one of the ways they check it is the level of creativity that the players display.
If they play in a way which is too creative, immediately the suspicion is, oh, they must be getting advice from an AI.
Now with with music, with film, or with writing books, we are still not there, of course.
Mhmm.
But when I look at the trend over the last ten years, you know, if I think what do I do when I write a book?

So first of all, I need to come up with a subject, like a question that really bothers me. Then I need to gather a lot of material, and I need to analyze it. And then I need to kind of put it in writing with I'm using stories and anecdotes and so forth. So these are the basic stages.
And when I look at each one of these stages, I can't see why AI will not be able to do that. For a long time, I had friends who say they will never be able to come up with the questions.

ask the AI To think of questions?
To come up with what are the kind of main kind of missing links, The things it would be very interesting to know and that we still don't know about a certain field or a certain subject.
And similarly, we we certainly gathering information and analyzing it.
You know, the amount of information that I can gather is is infinitesimal compared to to the AI.
And then all the way to writing amusing stories or anecdotes.
So I've already seen, you know, these wonderful stories written by AI. And I agree that humans will always want to create for the joy of creating, as children do. But would it still be valued?
I mean, until today, it's not just that we liked doing it, it was extremely valuable. Nothing on planet Earth could be as creative as as us.
And now in more and more fields, there is something which can be more creative.
And and lastly, I also really kind of connect to what you said that I can understand it in in my intellect, but deep inside, I I I tend to think about it as a kind of brain stomach barrier.
